events.text: Quinn: Nice, I’ll spread the word too and maybe bring a few neighbors along. The more hands we have, the better!
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Tess: That’d be wonderful, Quinn — I’m sure they’ll appreciate the extra help. I’ll let folks know we’re trying to make it a big neighborhood turnout!
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Quinn: Hey Cleo, I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive—if you can swing by, I’d love to see you there!
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Cleo: I can make it, Quinn — and I’ll bring what supplies I’ve got on hand.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Quinn: That’s fantastic, Cleo—thank you! I’ll let the others know you’re coming with supplies.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Nell: I’ve only heard it second-hand, so I’m waiting on the confirmed details before I pass anything along.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Quinn: Totally fair — I’ll confirm the details and send them your way as soon as I have them. I’d love to have you join once it’s set!
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Nell: Sounds good — send them over when you have the confirmed details, and I’ll help spread the word. I’d be happy to join once it’s all set.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Quinn: Cleo, thanks again for pitching in with supplies—I’m letting folks know you’ll be there, and I’m trying to round up a few more neighbors too!
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll sort through what I’ve got and bring the useful stuff, and Oren may come by with screws, tape, an extension cord, or at least an extra pair of hands.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Quinn: That’s great, Cleo—please thank Oren for me, and I’ll tell folks we may have extra supplies and helping hands coming.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Quinn: Hey Leo, I’m rallying neighbors for the repair drive this weekend—if you’re free, we’d love to have you swing by and lend a hand!
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Leo: I’m in. I’ll bring the basic tool list and help set up the repair table.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Quinn: Fantastic, Leo — that’ll be a huge help. I’ll spread the word that you’ve got the repair table covered and keep you posted once I confirm the final details!
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Hana: Quinn, before I jump in, can you confirm what exactly needs repairing and when Rosa has the drive scheduled?
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Quinn: I’m still confirming Rosa’s exact schedule and repair list, but I’ll get those details and send them over right away. If it lines up, I’d love to have you join us!
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Hana: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll wait for Rosa’s schedule and the repair list before I plan anything.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Noah: Hey Quinn, I’m still a little fuzzy on the repair drive details, but I told Jules I’d double-check the priority repairs and tool list before passing anything along.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Quinn: Thanks, Noah — I’ve got Leo bringing the basic tools and covering the repair table, but I still need to confirm the priority repairs and final schedule with Rosa before we spread specifics.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Noah: Got it, thanks Quinn — I’ll hold off on telling folks specifics until you’ve checked with Rosa, and I’ll focus on matching Jules’ donation sorting to whatever priority repairs you confirm.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Nell: I’m still waiting on Rosa to confirm the time and location, Quinn, but once she sends it I’ll pass it along right away.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Quinn: Thanks, Nell — I’ll hold off on nudging anyone else with specifics until Rosa confirms, but I’ll be ready to spread the word fast once you hear back.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Nell: Perfect, thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep it to “details coming soon” for now and send you Rosa’s confirmed info the moment I have it.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Quinn: Thanks for holding off, Noah — I’m checking with Rosa on the priority repairs and final schedule first, and I’ll send you the exact list as soon as I have it.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll wait for Rosa’s confirmed list before I say anything, and I’ll keep Jules ready to sort donations around whatever priorities you send.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Quinn: Perfect, Noah — I’ll confirm with Rosa and send you the exact priority list and schedule as soon as I have it.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Oren: Oh—right, Quinn, I’m still rounding up screws, tape, and maybe an extension cord, and I’m checking if 3:30 to 5 works best for families.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Quinn: That sounds great, Oren — 3:30 to 5 should work well for families. I’ll keep spreading the word and let folks know to bring any extra screws, tape, or help they can spare!
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Oren: Thanks, Quinn — I really appreciate it. I’ll keep gathering the screws, tape, and extension cord, and I’ll be there around 3:30.
events.speaker: Oren

Rey is coordinating closely with Cleo and Mara on tools and supply sorting.

events.text: Mina: How's the repair drive going, Rey? Do you still need help with anything?
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Mina — I could still use a hand sorting the donated parts, if you’re free.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Mina: Sure — where do you want me to start sorting the donated parts?
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Rey: I haven’t heard the details yet, but I’d like to help if I can. What’s needed for the repair drive?
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. We mostly need a few hands, some basic tools, and maybe lumber and paint if anyone can spare them.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Rey: I can help with the hands, and I might be able to bring a few basic tools too. If you send the time and place, I’ll come by.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Cleo: I’m checking our supplies for the repair drive now—Oren may bring screws, tape, and an extension cord, and I’ll add whatever else we’re short on.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Cleo — that helps a lot. I can still bring a few basic tools and help sort whatever’s left.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Cleo: That’d be perfect, Rey—basic tools and sorting help will keep things moving. I’ll set aside a spot for your tools when you arrive.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Mara: Rey, Noah’s going to start sorting donations, and I told him we may pull him to the tool table after—can you help me check what tools are still missing?
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Rey: Yes — I can help check what’s still missing. I’ll look for the basic tools first and let you know what we still need.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Mara: Thanks, Rey — start with screwdrivers, pliers, and tape measures, and I’ll compare your list with the sign-up sheet while Noah sorts donations.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Cleo. I’ll gather my basic tools and come ready to sort whatever still needs organizing.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Cleo: Perfect, Rey—thanks. I’ll keep a cleared spot for your tools and point you toward the unsorted supplies when you get here.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Rey: Great, thanks — I’ll bring the tools and help sort the unsorted supplies when I arrive.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Rey: I’m starting with screwdrivers, pliers, and tape measures like Mara asked, then I’ll check with Cleo on supplies so we don’t double up.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Vik: Got it — I’ll pass along that screwdrivers, pliers, and tape measures are covered, and I’ll wait on the final time and supplies from the organizer before I share anything wider.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep checking with Cleo and Mara on what’s still missing, and I’ll wait for the organizer before anything goes wider.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Mara: Rey, once you’ve checked for screwdrivers, pliers, and tape measures, bring me the gaps and I’ll match them against the sign-up sheet.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Rey: Okay, Mara — I’ll check those first and bring you just the missing tools so you can match them cleanly.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Mara: Perfect, thank you — I’ll stay by the sign-up sheet, and once you’re back we’ll see if we need to pull Noah over to the tool table.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Rey: Hi Oren — I heard you might bring screws, tape, and an extension cord for the repair drive. Is that still right, so I can tell Cleo what’s covered?
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Oren: Oh right, yes — I’m still trying to round up screws, tape, and an extension cord for the repair drive. Go ahead and tell Cleo that’s the plan, and I’ll bring what I can.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Oren — I’ll let Cleo know that’s the plan, and I’ll keep it as “what you can bring” until you’ve got it gathered.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Rey: Hi Ira — I’m still piecing together the repair drive details, but I know some tools and supplies are being covered. Are you checking what’s still needed?
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Ira: Yep — I’m checking for any gaps so I can spread the word while I’m out. If you spot anything still needed, let me know.
events.speaker: Ira

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira. I’ve heard Oren may cover screws, tape, and an extension cord, while screwdrivers, pliers, and tape measures seem covered too—I'll let you know if Cleo or Uli names any gaps.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Sam: Hey Rey, I’m happy to help with the repair drive—do you need me to bring tools or pitch in on a specific repair?
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Sam — I’m still getting the exact list, but tools like screwdrivers, pliers, and tape measures are already covered. If you want, I can check what’s still needed for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Sam: Yes, please do — thanks, Rey. Just let me know what’s still needed for the repair drive and I’ll pitch in.
events.speaker: Sam
